recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed unless future page chrome removes the footer link to toc.html.
issue_request: FHIR-5218 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 FHIR-core ballot issue asking for easier linear navigation through the web specification; the accepted proposal was to add a toc.html link from the bottom of every page, labeled "Specification Map" at the time.
initial_application: Historical commit 9c8cefdd39ab0146a6f0567ed4f7b0ff96085b6e, titled "#5218 - how to navigate spec?", added a footer link from the page-bottom template to <%level%>toc.html with the label "Specification Map".
additional_context: The footer template later moved from source/newfooter.html to tools/templates/newfooter.html, where the toc.html link remains. Current build source lists toc.html in publish.ini, titles it "Table of Contents" in source/hierarchy.xml and source/toc.html, and includes the newfooter template on 198 source HTML pages. FHIR-7378 later requested clearer ToC wording instead of "Specification Map" and is already represented on the combined branch by e9a17c17aafc3efd540eeb612c4d512048c2d1c1.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the requested page-bottom ToC navigation link is present in current build inputs, and restoring the obsolete "Specification Map" label would conflict with later naming direction.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue renamed the "Specification Map" wording toward "Table of Contents" and is already audited on the combined branch.
